headline: More than 1.6 million tons of raw milk produced in Kyrgyzstan since the beginning of the year
summary: Kyrgyzstan produced 1,658.7 thousand tonnes of raw milk in the first 10 months, exceeding last year's level by 2.3 percent, according to the data cited.
why: Raw milk output is a key indicator for Kyrgyzstan's agricultural sector, which supports rural incomes and food supply in the economy.
original_headline: Более 1,6 миллиона тонн сырого молока произвели в Кыргызстане с начала года
